name: TOTP
description: Time-based One-Time Password (RFC 6238). Compatible with Google Authenticator, Authy, and similar apps.

name: Message
description: Sends a one-time code via a configured notification channel (e.g., SMS, email).

parameters.name: notificationChannelName
parameters.description: Notification channel to use for delivering the code.

parameters.name: messageTemplate
parameters.description: Message template. Use %code% placeholder for the OTP code.
